announcement.title: 0.4.18-b4 — required update (VRChat API change)
announcement.message:
0.4.18-b4 is a required update. VRChat changed its API again, and this time it needed code changes rather than just a dependency bump: a field Scarlet reads on group posts was renamed upstream, so earlier builds cannot display group post roles correctly. Updating keeps VRChat and moderation features working.

Also in this build: group announcements now show their visibility, the roles they target, and who last edited them — matching what group posts already displayed.

Separately: there has been interest in a locally-hosted web UI for administering Scarlet. Because that would involve credential storage and administrator access, I want it done properly rather than improvised or AI-generated — I am looking for someone with genuine application-security experience to help design and build it. If that is you and you would like to contribute, please reach out in the Discord.
